marta_k: Summarizing the postmortem follow-ups so we actually ship tests. Short thread.
dave_s: Please paste the RCAs so we can map owners.
marta_k: RCAs -> (1) eviction debt under burst windows (KV backlog), (2) tokenizer shim mismatch in quant fallback, (3) canonicalizer dropping invisible chars leading to cache misses.
lee_w: I'll own (1). Plan: add a targeted chaos attack + a sustained 10m ramp profile to reproduce eviction debt. I'll add a lightweight staging smoke job.
olivia_r: I'll own (2). Deterministic model-consistency eval: 200 paired prompts, fixed seed, temp=0, token-diff gate 1.0%. Will persist raw outputs for forensic diffs.
dave_s: I'll do (3) prompt canonicalizer unit tests + a 60-item promptset from incident traces. Path: eng-ml/evals/promptsets/pm-2027-evict-canonical.
incidents-bot: Reminder: create follow-up ticket labeled incident-followup + tests-required. Template: pm->testplan.
marta_k: Proposed actions: - KV chaos + ramp (owner: lee_w) - Model-consistency eval + CI job (owner: olivia_r) - Canonicalizer tests + promptset (owner: dave_s) - Add `burst-evict-10m` to weekly soak matrix (owner: lee_w)
lee_w: Chaos snippet to iterate: `chaosctl attack kv-evict --profile=ramp-10m --pool=serve-main --collect=eviction-lag,cache-miss`
olivia_r: CI: add `eval/quant-consistency` GitHub Action to run nightly for 7 days post-merge and post JSON summary to #eng-ml-evals. Auto-open `eval/regression` issue if gate trips.
dave_s: Timeline: KV smoke in 48h, promptset PR in 72h, eval PR in 5 days, soak matrix update next week.
incidents-bot: Follow-up ticket INF-4820 created and linked to postmortem. Owners assigned.
marta_k: Note recurring pattern: eviction debt seen ~every 6 weeks. Adding `burst-evict-10m` to monthly targeted soak recommended.
lee_w: Starting KV smoke now, will upload traces to INF-4820 when done.
olivia_r: Draft eval PR by Monday. Will include deterministic ordering and raw artifacts.
dave_s: Promptset curation in progress; PR by Thu.
marta_k: Please post one-line updates here as items land so we can close INF-4820. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
